title: AlphaFold wins CASP14 for protein folding
summary: AlphaFold achieved a median GDT score of 92.4 across the target set (about 1.6 Å mean error) and 87.0 on the hardest targets, which organizers judged a solution to the problem of single-protein structures. DeepMind notes that protein complexes and interactions with other molecules remain open challenges.

evidence.tested: Blind assessment at CASP14 on recently determined protein structures: median GDT of 92.4 across targets and 87.0 on the hardest free-modelling targets, judged by the organizers as a solution to single-protein structure prediction.
evidence.unknown: Protein complexes, interactions with DNA, RNA or small molecules, and full side-chain placement remain open; not every predicted structure will be perfect.
evidence.ai_role: Attention-based neural network using evolutionary sequence alignments and residue-pair representations to predict 3D protein structure from sequence.
